localChanges: Caravans and Diplomats no longer cost their home city a shield, and they don't make citizens unhappy when they leave home. They can now slip past enemy units, but they can't attack or capture a city (closes #34).

Under the Republic and Democracy, only armed units make citizens unhappy: a Transport away from home no longer does, but an aircraft with an attack does even while it's in its home city (closes #181).
